name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a conditional 'whenever the ball is out of the way, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later', which is exactly a hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key); no unconditional goal is commanded, so the rule-only warning with an empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

texts: Whenever blocker_moved happens, has_door_key must also happen at some point: before, with, or after blocker_moved.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !blocker_moved&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u2
(u0, blocker_moved&has_door_key) -> u1
(u2, has_door_key) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u2) -> -1
(u2, has_door_key, u1) -> 1
